spans.text: Magnhilda hesitates, then adjusts her yukata in a clumsy yet careful way before sitting down.

units.rawText: You've been taking me to all kinds of places and doing all sorts of things with me tonight, and you even gave me a gift, but I haven't done anything for you.
units.displayText: You've been taking me to all kinds of places and doing all sorts of things with me tonight, and you even gave me a gift, but I haven't done anything for you.

spans.text: You've been taking me to all kinds of places and doing all sorts of things with me tonight, and you even gave me a gift, but I haven't done anything for you.

units.rawText: While I don't really understand the practices at lantern fairs and events like these... I believe the feeling is mutual?
units.displayText: While I don't really understand the practices at lantern fairs and events like these... I believe the feeling is mutual?

spans.text: While I don't really understand the practices at lantern fairs and events like these... I believe the feeling is mutual?

units.rawText: Even if it's like what you said just now and a gift isn't necessary... I'm not good at expressing myself with words.
units.displayText: Even if it's like what you said just now and a gift isn't necessary... I'm not good at expressing myself with words.

spans.text: Even if it's like what you said just now and a gift isn't necessary... I'm not good at expressing myself with words.

units.rawText: No matter what, I want to let you know how I feel, so...
units.displayText: No matter what, I want to let you know how I feel, so...

spans.text: No matter what, I want to let you know how I feel, so...

units.rawText: Magnhilda opens the bento box she's holding.
units.displayText: Magnhilda opens the bento box she's holding.

spans.text: Magnhilda opens the bento box she's holding.

units.rawText: The lantern fair was fun. Although I might not have expressed myself that clearly, I was enjoying myself.
units.displayText: The lantern fair was fun. Although I might not have expressed myself that clearly, I was enjoying myself.

spans.text: The lantern fair was fun. Although I might not have expressed myself that clearly, I was enjoying myself.

units.rawText: Thank you for bringing me all over the place and letting me experience such novel things, Professor.
units.displayText: Thank you for bringing me all over the place and letting me experience such novel things, Professor.

spans.text: Thank you for bringing me all over the place and letting me experience such novel things, Professor.

units.rawText: Magnhilda shifts in her seat and looks seriously at me. Her tone is a little stiff, but her meaning is gentle enough.
units.displayText: Magnhilda shifts in her seat and looks seriously at me. Her tone is a little stiff, but her meaning is gentle enough.

spans.text: Magnhilda shifts in her seat and looks seriously at me. Her tone is a little stiff, but her meaning is gentle enough.

units.rawText: I'll do my best to learn about things other than boxing... about the things that you find interesting, so our next outing won't be as boring, or as tiring for you.
units.displayText: I'll do my best to learn about things other than boxing... about the things that you find interesting, so our next outing won't be as boring, or as tiring for you.

spans.text: I'll do my best to learn about things other than boxing... about the things that you find interesting, so our next outing won't be as boring, or as tiring for you.

units.rawText: That is, if you want to ask me out again.
units.displayText: That is, if you want to ask me out again.

spans.text: That is, if you want to ask me out again.

units.rawText: Saying so, Magnhilda takes out the other stick of candied fruit from the lunchbox and hands it to me.
units.displayText: Saying so, Magnhilda takes out the other stick of candied fruit from the lunchbox and hands it to me.

spans.text: Saying so, Magnhilda takes out the other stick of candied fruit from the lunchbox and hands it to me.

units.rawText: These are candied strawberries. They might look hard on the outside, but they're soft on the inside and fill your mouth with sweetness when you eat them.
units.displayText: These are candied strawberries. They might look hard on the outside, but they're soft on the inside and fill your mouth with sweetness when you eat them.

spans.text: These are candied strawberries. They might look hard on the outside, but they're soft on the inside and fill your mouth with sweetness when you eat them.

units.rawText: When I saw them, I thought of you, Professor... So I wonder if my feelings have reached you?
units.displayText: When I saw them, I thought of you, Professor... So I wonder if my feelings have reached you?

spans.text: When I saw them, I thought of you, Professor... So I wonder if my feelings have reached you?

units.rawText: The fireworks blossom in the background, and their light is reflected in Magnhilda's eyes.
units.displayText: The fireworks blossom in the background, and their light is reflected in Magnhilda's eyes.

spans.text: The fireworks blossom in the background, and their light is reflected in Magnhilda's eyes.

units.rawText: Happy Qixi, Professor.
units.displayText: Happy Qixi, Professor.

spans.text: Happy Qixi, Professor.

units.rawText: And in her golden eyes, I see mirth hidden deep within their placid depths, as well as a hint of longing.
units.displayText: And in her golden eyes, I see mirth hidden deep within their placid depths, as well as a hint of longing.
